context_text: Retail sales analytics schema. A "basket" is a single checkout transaction, not a product bundle. Revenue columns are net of returns and expressed in USD. store_id joins to dim_store; customer_id joins to dim_customer.

Fact tables (fct_ prefix) are at line-item grain: one row per product per basket. Columns ending in _qty are unit counts; columns ending in _amt are monetary measures in USD. event_dt is the transaction date in UTC.
One row per loyalty-program customer. loyalty_tier codes: B=bronze, S=silver, G=gold. email_hash is a salted hash used only for joins and must not be treated as a contactable email address.
